title: The summary of Tuesday 17 November
text:
Good morning, it is Tuesday 17 November: this is the GERICO summary.

Let's start with Ukraine. Overnight Russian missiles struck two bridges over the Dnipro in Kyiv, the North and the South. This was stated by Mayor Klitschko, who spoke of neighbourhoods without water and heating. Immediately afterwards Moscow said that Ukrainian forces attacked the Crimean bridge again. The day before, the Russian Defence Ministry said it had shot down 1,336 Ukrainian drones, a record. These are Russian figures, not verified.

On the American front, CNN reports that intelligence officials speak of Iranian plans for an attack on Washington. The White House responds that there are no credible threats. Meanwhile Trump opens his trip to Asia with the Quad summit in Manila, then he will be in China, where a meeting with Xi and Putin is expected on Thursday in Shenzhen.

In Italy, the Caltanissetta prosecutor's office served a notice of investigation to former police chief Gianni De Gennaro, for misleading the investigation into the via D'Amelio massacre. It is an investigation: there is no conviction. New emails with bomb scares arrived in schools. No school was evacuated.

In the United States, new rules against China's remote access to advanced chips. And on Monday an outage left thousands of customers of JPMorgan and other major banks without access to their online accounts for hours.

Let's move on to the markets. Wall Street closed sharply down on Monday. The Nasdaq lost 2.5%, the S&P 500 1.9%, the Dow Jones over 700 points. Nvidia fell by 4%, following the resignation of Chief Executive Officer Jensen Huang. The company's earnings are released today after the close.

This morning Asia follows Wall Street. The Nikkei loses 1.45%, the Kospi 1.93%, the Hang Seng 0.77%.

In Europe, yesterday the stock exchanges closed slightly lower. Piazza Affari lost 0.65%, to 51,520 points. Frankfurt minus 0.6%, Paris and London minus 0.2%. The spread between BTPs and Bunds rose to 106 bp. Gas fell by 7%, below 84 euros per megawatt-hour.

On other commodities and foreign exchange, gold, oil and the dollar, we have no verified data from this morning. Bitcoin, according to Ansa, was on Sunday at around 62,000 dollars, the lowest level in four months.

On today's calendar, at 14:30 in the United States October retail sales are released, expected to rise by 0.1%. Core sales are expected at 0.4%.

The full news, with sources, is on GERICO. No investment advice.
